messages:
Beth (Sales): Hi team — uploading the OmniHealth RFP pack. Quick asks: 1) final capability matrix (CSV) attached? 2) POC pricing for Dedicated w/ 2-week eval — confirm numbers. 3) security Qs flagged sections 4 & 9 need answers. Link: https://drive.redwood.example/omni-rfp-pack

Anna (Solutions Eng): Thanks Beth. I'll update the matrix now. For POC pricing do you want dedicated GPUs or shared burst? If dedicated, need region and expected qps.

James (AE): OmniHealth prefers predictable latency so dedicated. Target: 250 qps ingest, peak 400. Region: us-east-1. Budget: looking for monthly commit.

Mike (Infra): For 250 qps with gen-2 models, recommend 4xA100 or 8xH100 equiv. Preliminary pricing: $28k/mo reserved for 3-month POC. I'll add calc.

Anna (Solutions Eng): Uploaded draft CSV: https://drive.redwood.example/omni-matrix.csv
Preview:
```
feature,redwood,compA,compB
multi-deploy,yes,limited,yes
kv-cache,yes,no,partial
private-vpc,yes,yes,no
```
Will tweak the language on on-prem HSM note.

Sara (Security): Re: sections 4 & 9 — I've filled answers for encryption at rest and key rotation. For HSM we can support customer-managed KMS + HSM integration; need their vendor list. I've attached a redacted sample answer.

redwood-bot: New file uploaded by Anna: omni-matrix.csv

Beth (Sales): Great. @Sara can you inline the HSM vendor compatibility blurb in the final doc? @Mike can you confirm the SLA we should promise for POC (latency p95)?

Mike (Infra): For that POC SLA let's aim 95th percentile <= 120ms on generation with pinned model variants, else we say 'best-effort' for bursts. Will add to doc.

James (AE): Also need escalation matrix + contact list for legal review — attaching the legal intake link: https://legal.redwood.example/intake?case=omni

Anna (Solutions Eng): Will produce final ZIP with capability matrix, security Qs, pricing workbook and sample config. ETA EOD PST. :thumbsup:

Beth (Sales): Perfect. If anyone has outstanding blockers call them out now. Otherwise I'll send to OmniHealth procurement after Anna's package.

Sara (Security): No blockers from my side, just need their HSM vendor list (one email).

Mike (Infra): No infra blockers.

James (AE): I'll queue the commercial terms draft with Legal.

Beth (Sales): Thanks all. :clap:
